summary: Tested the 'Próxima Cita' feature in Evaluación Oftalmológica end to end (backend + UI). Backend: 10/10 tests passed, 1 skipped. GET /api/agenda/horarios-disponibles returns {disponible, motivo, slots, duracion}. On a Monday it returns 15 slots (08:00-11:30, every 15 min; Dr. Méndez works Monday 08:00-12:00 only). On a Sunday it returns disponible=false, motivo 'El médico no atiende ese día', slots=[]. An invalid date returns 400 and a missing token returns 401/403. POST /api/agenda/proxima-cita creates the appointment with estado Agendada, and the tipo_cita and notas show up in GET /agenda/citas. A duplicate returns 400. Sunday, out-of-hours (23:00) and a blocked time range all return 409 with the reason. A full slot (max_citas_por_slot=3) disappears from the list. UI: the tipo selector shows exactly the 6 types with 'Control' as default. Choosing a Sunday shows the proxima-cita-motivo message and disables the hora selector ('Sin horarios'). Choosing a Monday fills the selector with proxima-cita-slot-* options. Saving creates the appointment (toasts 'Próxima cita agendada' + 'Evaluación guardada correctamente'). It appears in Agenda Calendario/Día and Tablero del Día with 'Lectura de estudios' and the note. Saving again shows the info toast 'Ya existe una cita para esa fecha y hora' and the evaluation still saves.

minor.issue: Does not enforce max_citas_por_slot. A 4th appointment at a slot that horarios-disponibles already treats as full was accepted (200). Only the frontend list blocks it, so a direct API call or a stale UI can overbook.
No check against past dates or past times. Appointments dated 2026-06-15 were created even though the server date is 2026-10-15. The frontend min attribute on the date field is the only guard.

integration_issues.issue: guardarEvaluacion calls createProximaCita on every save. Saving again unchanged shows a 'Ya existe una cita' toast each time. If the user changes the hour or date and saves again, a SECOND appointment is created and the first one stays (duplicate appointments for the patient). Suggest storing the created cita id on the evaluation (or setting agendar=false / showing 'cita agendada' after success) and updating that cita instead of creating a new one.

issues: The Fecha field is the browser's native input type=date, not the shadcn Calendar/Popover
The checkbox (#agendar_cita), Médico select, Fecha input and Notas input have no data-testid (only tipo/hora/slot/motivo do)

action_items: Prevent duplicate or extra appointments when an evaluation with agendar=true is saved again (keep track of the created cita and update it instead)
Enforce max_citas_por_slot and reject past dates/times in POST /api/agenda/proxima-cita
Add data-testid to proxima-cita checkbox, médico select, fecha input and notas input; consider the shadcn date picker
critical_code_review_comments: EvaluacionOftalmologica.js is about 3287 lines and agenda.py about 1384 lines; both should be split
horarios_disponibles repeats the bloqueo/horario logic from verificar_bloqueo/verificar_horario_medico (DRY); share it so GET and POST cannot drift (e.g. the max_por_slot check exists only in GET)
The duplicate check in crear_proxima_cita matches paciente+fecha+hora_inicio only, so the same patient can still get an appointment that overlaps by 5-15 minutes
seed_data_creation: Test appointments (paciente_id/notas prefixed TEST_) and a TEST_bloqueo were created and then deleted. The UI test saved one evaluation for patient María García López (8c8723a3-...) on the server date 2026-10-15; that evaluation was not deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The container clock is 2026-10-15, so the suggested dates 2026-06-14/15 are in the past (the backend accepts them anyway). For UI tests use a future Monday such as 2026-10-26. Dr. Carlos Méndez (a8bb541a-...) works only Monday 08:00-12:00 (other days inactive). The 'Nueva' button clears the selected patient, so click Nueva first and then search/select the patient. Agenda day slots use data-testid slot-<medicoId>-<HH:MM>.
